info.name: Gapify API
info.description:
This is the API documentation for Gapify server.

Generated from the OpenAPI (Swagger 2.0) spec at https://app.gapify.ai/developers/api/api.json (version 1.0.0).

## Authentication
All keys are sent in the `api-access-token` header. Set these collection variables:

- `api_access_token` - user API key (default for most requests)
- `platform_app_api_key` - used by the Platform folder
- `agent_bot_api_key` - for agent-bot-only endpoints

- **userApiKey**: This token can be obtained by visiting the profile page or via rails console. Provides access to  endpoints based on the user permissions levels. This token can be saved by an external system when user is created via API, to perform activities on behalf of the user.
- **agentBotApiKey**: This token should be provided by system admin or obtained via rails console. This token can be used to build bot integrations and can only access limited apis.
- **platformAppApiKey**: This token can be obtained by the system admin after creating a platformApp. This token should be used to provision agent bots, accounts, users and their roles.

Contact: hi@gapify.ai

request.description:
Creating a conversation in Gapify requires a source id. Auth: User API key **or** Agent bot API key (header `api-access-token`). **Request body** - `source_id` *string* **required** - Conversation source id - `inbox_id` *string* **required** - Id of inbox in which the conversation is created
Allowed Inbox Types: Website, Phone, Api, Email - `contact_id` *string* - Contact Id for which conversation is created - `additional_attributes` *object* - Lets you specify attributes like browser information - `custom_attributes` *object* - The object to save custom attributes for conversation, accepts custom attributes key and value - `status` *string* enum: `open`, `resolved`, `pending` - Specify the conversation whether it's pending, open, closed - `assignee_id` *string* - Agent Id for assigning a conversation to an agent - `team_id` *string* - Team Id for assigning a conversation to a team - `message` *object* - The initial message to be sent to the conversation - `content` *string* **required** - The content of the message - `template_params` *object* - The template params for the message in case of whatsapp Channel - `name` *string* - Name of the template - `category` *string* - Category of the template - `language` *string* - Language of the template - `processed_params` *object* - The processed param values for template variables in template **Responses** - `200` Success - `403` Access denied
